clips.title: A Billion Users and $TON Is at $1.26?
clips.hook: Very, very bullish on Gram, on TON.
clips.caption:
Over a billion monthly users on Telegram. Every crypto mini app in Telegram has to run on TON, and the built-in Gram wallet is rolled out to the whole user base.

That's distribution nobody else has.

$TON at $1.26. The all-time high was $7.88... I don't know if you can get better than this. 🚀

clips.title: One of the Last Chances Any of Us Have to Get Ahead
clips.hook: I do think this is going to be one of the last opportunities that any of us have to actually get ahead.
clips.caption:
AI is exploding at an exponential level. So many jobs are going to be taken away, and everything is going to become so damn cheap.

It's going to be difficult for anybody to make a decent amount of money. You gotta buy into those assets before all this happens.

One year ago it wasn't like this. Imagine what it's going to be like one year from now...
